insight_source: Claude Code just got Opus 4.6 with 1M context window. This changes everything for AI coding agents.

acts.label: HOOK
acts.text: (Upbeat, slightly mysterious music intro) Claude Opus 4.6 just quietly doubled its context window to 1M. Seriously, nobody’s talking about this game-changer for coding agents. It’s about to completely rewrite the rules.

acts.label: CURIOSITY BUILD
acts.text: Remember wrestling with complex coding projects?  You’d painstakingly copy and paste snippets, hoping for a connection.  Existing coding assistants struggled with anything beyond a few hundred lines.  That’s the bottleneck – the inability to truly *understand* the whole project's context.

acts.label: VALUE DELIVERY
acts.text: Opus 4.6’s massive 1 million context window changes everything.  It can now analyze entire codebases, understand complex dependencies, and even suggest improvements across multiple files simultaneously.  Imagine debugging with the full picture, not just isolated errors.  This isn’t just about longer prompts; it’s about genuine comprehension.

acts.label: EMOTIONAL PEAK
acts.text: Let’s be honest – staring at a wall of code, feeling completely lost, is a universal developer experience.  This technology finally tackles that feeling head-on, offering real support and unlocking your potential.  It’s like having a brilliant senior developer constantly reviewing your work, without the ego.

acts.label: CTA
acts.text: This is a seismic shift in AI coding.  Follow Daena for more insights into the future of AI development.  Save this video to revisit it later!
